user.title: Star Wi-Fi (Climastar)
user.description: Sign in with the email and password of the Star Wi-Fi app. The password is used once and is not stored.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Star Wi-Fi cloud.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

data_description.allow_control: Off: Home Assistant only reads the heaters. On: it can change setpoint, mode, on/off and the weekly plan.

set_schedule.name: Set weekly plan
set_schedule.description: Saves a new weekly plan in the Star Wi-Fi cloud and sends it to the heater, like the app's Save. Takes about 20 seconds. Needs 'Allow control'.

week.name: Week
week.description: 7 texts, Monday first, each 24 characters, one per hour: 0 off, 1 comfort (the setpoint), 2 eco.
